chunk_map.heading: You cannot read it all, so read where you know most

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 1 L4 (slide L4 of slides/you-cannot-read-it-all.md): 'It is the fastest way to stop checking at page three.' closest: 'It' resolves to 'Reading every line' in the preceding sentence; 'Each of you owns a source' names its source nouns in-sentence. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.
no 'opening lecture'/'earlier file'/'the X said' pointer in body; grep of body_numbered for positional callbacks: none. Slide stands alone.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward reference in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/reveal demo beat; slide is prose claim, no terminal scene

rules_evaluated.evidence: slide carries three self-contained claims (read where you know most; find least-trusted line; ask for ranked list with sources); not a wait-state.

header 'You cannot read it all, so read where you know most' matches body: P1 'cannot read it all', P2 'Read where you know the most instead'. Closest: P3 (ranked list) is not in the header but extends it as the ask; no contradiction.

grep: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.'; closest L4 'Reading every line is not control. It is the fastest way...' is one negation + one declarative, not the triple. L6 'your interviews, your tickets, your numbers' is a concrete noun list inside one sentence, not sentence anaphora. No superlative self-grading, no number+retraction, no abstraction stack, no verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: no repo/maintainer dialect in body; 'digest', 'source', 'ranked list' are ordinary product-team words. 'control' is plain English here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep '\*\*' on body_numbered: 0 bold elements; budget <=1 met.
